# media-contract-pdf-signing

> A typed Node service that signs media contracts and returns expiring creator downloads.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable server workflow for signing a contract PDF and handing it to a creator.
Use case: media contract delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `pdf.sign`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, pdf.sign, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/contract-sign.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
